summary.intent: Execute Phase 35 (Phala Testnet TEE Migration) to migrate the TEE worker from a root monorepo structure into apps/tee-worker/ with Phala Cloud CVM deployment, shared package integration, unit tests, Phala SDK instrumentation, and staging CI/CD updates.
summary.outcome: All 6 plans across 4 waves executed successfully. TEE worker restructured, 56+ unit tests added, Phala SDK integrated, CVM deployed to Phala Cloud production (not testnet), epoch key determinism and end-to-end IPNS republish verified, PR #395 created and multiple rounds of security/code review comments addressed.

repo: Phala Cloud has no separate testnet — the free tier runs on the same production nodes (Intel TDX hardware, dstack-pha-prodN) as paid deployments. Phase was named 'phala-testnet' but deployed to production infrastructure.
Docker is not available on the dev machine — it runs on a separate Docker host at 192.168.133.12 (updated from 192.168.133.114).
The deploy-staging.yml workflow has build-tee and deploy-tee-phala jobs that automatically build and deploy the CVM on staging-v* tag pushes.
TEE_WORKER_SECRET is used as a shared secret between the API and TEE worker; both sides get it from STAGING_TEE_WORKER_SECRET GitHub secret during CI.
The entire branch stores full conversation transcripts as checkpoints — credentials shared in conversation will be captured there.
gsd-tools init must run from the correct worktree directory (not the main repo) when working in a worktree.
multiformats (CID.parse) is already a dependency of @cipherbox/crypto and can be added to tee-worker for standard CID validation.
undici is bundled with Node.js and can be used for DNS-pinned fetch with custom Agent lookup to prevent TOCTOU DNS rebinding attacks.

code.finding: Originally called getKeypair() instead of getPublicKey(), leaking private key into route scope — fixed during /simplify review.
Was reading TEE_EPOCH env var but migrate route uses TEE_CURRENT_EPOCH — inconsistency fixed during /simplify review.
DNS pinning via hostname rewrite broke TLS SNI/certificate validation — fixed by using undici Agent with custom lookup function that validates the resolved IP before connecting.
SSRF check compared endpoint !== 'cipherbox' instead of protocol !== 'cipherbox', meaning cipherbox:// URLs were not excluded from SSRF validation.
Epoch assignment using ?? parseInt(process.env.TEE_CURRENT_EPOCH || '1', 10) could yield NaN if env var is non-numeric — fixed to fall back to 1.
teePrivateKey not zeroed if decryptEcies or validateEndpointUrl threw before the finally block — fixed by wrapping entire function body in try/finally.
Kubo's pin() uses cid-version=1 and returns CIDv1, so direct string equality comparison against input CIDv0 always fails — fixed by normalizing both to CIDv1 via CID.parse().toV1().toString().
Unmatched route label should be '/:unmatched' (matching API's http-metrics.interceptor.ts:40 pattern) not 'unmatched' — fixed per CodeRabbit review.
decryptEcies silently accepted malformed hex (Buffer.from with 'hex' encoding ignores invalid chars) — fixed with early validation checking non-empty, even-length, valid hex before Buffer conversion.
FetchFn type was exported from types.ts but not re-exported from the package index, forcing consumers to deep-import or use ProviderOptions['fetchFn'].

workflow: GSD pause-work/resume-work successfully transferred session state between machines — credentials stored in HANDOFF.json enabled seamless continuation on the Docker host.
Secrets shared in conversation (pasted by user or echoed by assistant) are captured in the entire branch checkpoints — rotate credentials immediately after any session where they appear.
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code runtime bug fires after tool calls complete — spot-check SUMMARY.md + commits to determine real success/failure.
Parallel wave agents should use sequential fallback when git config lock contention occurs (35-02 initial attempt failed due to this).
Security reviews should be committed as planning artifacts and updated with resolution status after fixes are applied.
CID version mismatch is a common subtle bug when comparing user-supplied CIDs against Kubo-returned CIDs (Kubo normalizes to CIDv1 with cid-version=1 flag).

friction: Usage limits interrupted Wave 2 mid-execution (35-03 hit limit), requiring manual continuation after reset.
gsd-tools init failed initially because it ran from the main repo path instead of the worktree — needed explicit cd to worktree.
Parallel Wave 2 execution caused git config lock contention on 35-02, requiring sequential retry.
STATE.md merge conflicts occurred multiple times as agent worktrees and the main branch diverged — needed manual resolution each time.
Docker not available on dev machine required a two-machine workflow (dev machine for code, Docker host for image building), necessitating the pause/resume handoff.
undici types not automatically available despite being bundled with Node — required explicit pnpm add undici.
The entire branch checkpoint system has no secret scrubbing mechanism — credentials in conversation are permanently captured.
HANDOFF.json stale data (Dockerfile fix note) caused minor confusion on resume — stale notes not automatically cleaned up.
The Phala phase name 'phala-testnet' was a misnomer from the start — no testnet exists, but renaming would break cross-references so it was left as-is.
open_items: Probe/connection-test deduplication: connection-test.ts reimplements probe logic that exists in sdk-core — deferred as significant refactor.
Rotate PHALA_CLOUD_API_KEY and STAGING_TEE_WORKER_SECRET — user handled rotation but old values remain in git history on the phase branch and entire branch checkpoint.
The entire branch transcript at 86/0546ed796e/0/full.jsonl contains the old (now rotated) Phala API key — inert but present.
HUMAN-UAT.md for Phase 35 has status: partial — will surface in /gsd:progress and /gsd:audit-uat until explicitly resolved.
Phase 35 branch needs merging to main — PR #395 created but not yet merged.
Sequential IPNS key processing in republish (deliberate security tradeoff, not concurrency-optimized) — documented as intentional but could be revisited for performance.
Latency baselines (~1155ms avg) are from testnet conditions (dev machine → Phala Cloud); production co-located performance unvalidated.
